sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
-Target: all allies. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 40% of max HP every 5 seconds for 20 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Applies a 60-second counter heal that recovers 50000 HP each time damage is received.
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
